DmAttachmentReserveRequest.description:
miy: attachment reservation. AI-DO received the multipart file here; miy
reserves platform storage first and the bytes follow through the file
gateway (`runtime.fileApi`).

mentions.description: Mention ranges of the new trimmed body (replace the old ones).

download_url.description: miy: an app file path for `runtime.fileApi` (AI-DO: a signed URL).

deleted.description: miy: deleted by the author; body "" and no attachments.

edited_at.description: miy: when the author last edited the body ("수정됨").

mentions.description: miy: mention ranges (UTF-16 code units of `body`).

reactions.description: miy: reactions in the fixed order, with who reacted.

deleted.description: miy: the quoted message was deleted by its author.

DmReactionItem.description: miy: one reaction of a message.

reacted.description: The caller is among the people who reacted.

manager.description:
miy: the caller holds the messenger manager role (shows the report
review screen link). Display only; the server rechecks every call.

manager_claimable.description: Nobody holds the role yet. The claim endpoint still checks atomically.

body.description: Provide a nonblank body, an attachment, or both.

mentions.description: miy: mention ranges of the trimmed body.

email.description: miy: the directory has no e-mail; always "".

edited_at.description: miy: edits and deletion (with the texts kept while a report is open).

locale.description: English labels for en-US and Korean labels otherwise.

timeZone.description: Time zone supplied by the platform. Messenger uses the locale for labels.

claimable.description: Nobody holds the role yet: the caller may claim it.

message_deleted.description: miy: the author deleted the reported message.
